patch_description: The current two-hop rewards can accumulate across all possible relays for each OD pair, making indirect support dominate the direct-link signal. This version keeps the direct reward mostly linear in demand and caps each OD pair’s *aggregate* two-hop reward at 75% of its direct reward, scaling its candidate paths proportionally when necessary. Relay pressure and component-edge demand still determine the relative ranking of paths. The cap controls cumulative influence without increasing the quadratic-term count; the degree penalty remains evaluator-supplied.
